Neighbour mirrors still missing, to be added by their owners: denmark-norway (eu-14-g) has no Danish occupation of northern Swedish Pomerania (December 1715 to 17 January 1721) or Wismar (1716 to about 1721) and no Alvsborg-roles-reversed check of its L10/L11 against this ledger; tsardom-of-russia (eu-16) has no 1656-1661 occupation of the Baltic edge and no Tartu (24 June 1704) or Narva (20 August 1704) losses; polish-lithuanian-commonwealth (eu-15) needs the contest and cession of Livonia 1621-1622 (this ledger moved the Livonian gain from 1629 to November 1622) and the Swedish occupation of Greater Poland, Masovia, Lesser Poland and Royal Prussia 1655-1660; kingdom-of-prussia (eu-09) has no Pomeranian War 1757-1762; first-french-empire (eu-20) the occupation of Swedish Pomerania 1807-1810; russian-empire (eu-17) the occupation of Finland from 21 February 1808.

Three dossiers date the hand-over of Farther Pomerania differently: swedish-empire (occupation 1637-3 to 1653 cp brandenburg-prussia, no loss), swedish-pomerania (gain of the whole duchy 1637-3, loss 1648-10, contest to 4 May 1653) and brandenburg-prussia (contest 1648-10 to 1653, gain 1653). prince-archbishopric-of-bremen and prince-bishopric-of-verden date the secularisation to 15 May 1648, this ledger the Swedish gain to 24 October 1648 (Westphalia). The east-bank strip of 1679 is a Brandenburg gain in brandenburg-prussia but a pawn until 1693 on the Swedish Pomerania page.

Disagreements with the reviewer (reasons and pages in the notes file): Bremen-Verden occupation starts 1643 (page span 1643-1645) rather than 1645-8; southern Pomerania occupation starts 1715 rather than 1713 (only the 1715 takeover is on a page); Farther Pomerania has no loss event; the Cardis occupation region is Cliopatria's difference and is probably too wide in Ingria.

Swedish-empire is still the same state as kingdom-of-sweden (one colour and family, or merge); the colour agent should treat the Russian, Danish, Prussian, Hanoverian and French occupation events of this ledger as hatching of Swedish land, not as gains of those states.
